Instrument.name: Phoenix Lander Telltale
Instrument.description: The Phoenix Lander Telltale wind indicator was a mechanical anemometer designed to operate on the Martian surface as part of the meteorological package on the NASA Phoenix lander. It consisted of a lightweight cylinder suspended by Kevlar fibers and was deflected under the action of wind. Imaging of the Telltale deflection with the Surface Stereo Imager (SSI) allowed the wind speed and direction to be quantified. Wind measurements were made with a frequency determined by how frequently the SSI could take images (down to once every 50 seconds).
